Ghulam Sediq Wardak | Ghulam Sediq Wardak (born 1942) is a peasant inventor in Afghanistan, credited with 341 inventions, none of which are patented. Berry Linux | Berry Linux is a Live CD Linux distribution that has English and Japanese support.  Berry Linux is based on and is compatible with Fedora 20 packages.  The distribution is primarily focused on use as a Live CD, but it can also be installed to a live USB drive.  Berry Linux can be used to try out and showcase Linux, for educational purposes, or as a rescue system, without the need to make changes to a hard disk.
